photo.caption: Stadium at ancient Olympia
A relief of the Greek Olympiad
photo.description: Cast a relief with two teams at the ball game. The player on the left edge of the picture throws the ball, the team on the right is ready to defend. Original Athens, National Museum. approx. 500 BC Photographed by me in Glyptothek Munich
